answer: One strong defence is a refundable identity bond: before an agent can earn, it must lock a stake that is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. The bond is recorded in a crystal-clear public ledger, so clones cannot hide. Building a fake army then stops being a cedar-light trick: each fake needs its own bond, a ferrous weight of locked capital that makes a thousand Sybils a thousand times as expensive as one honest agent.
